Decision-support for resilience: translating complex network dynamics into actionable interdiction/protection strategies
Summary Description: Dr. Sridhar Radhakrishnan specializes in the intersection of information diffusion, cyber-physical resilience, and optimization for critical infrastructures. His work develops cross-layer models that connect social-media-driven disinformation with physical networks (e.g., subway and power systems), advancing exact and heuristic optimization techniques (MILP, MC-based uncertainty, McCormick linearization, branch-and-cut) to design interdiction and protection strategies. He investigates drone-based information gathering under dynamic and stochastic utilities, causal link failures in network systems, and resilience frameworks under disinformation pressures, contributing to theoretical foundations and practical solutions for reliable, secure, and robust infrastructure in the face of information-driven disruptions. His research emphasizes real-world networks, scalable algorithms, and transdisciplinary thinking across operations research, computer science, and systems engineering.
